Ever since I started jailbreaking my own smartphone, I realized I am a software engineer.

I am a detail oriented person who can learn new technologies and implement those skills very quickly. I’ve had amazing opportunities to build web applications using Javascript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, mongoDB, Firebase, Express, Node.js, HTML/CSS, React/Redux, Vue/Vuex. When I am not busy coding and creating, I enjoy catching up on my Korean TV shows and listening to music as I sing along.

projects.title: Voistris
projects.description:
Voitris is a classic Tetris game with two options for controller (Voice and Keyboard).

 | JavaScript | HTML5 | CSS3 | Canvas | MongoDB | Express |

- Implemented Tetris algorithms that allow user to easily switch, move and hold Tetris blocks.
- Applied SpeechRecognition interface from Webkit Speech API to record and and translate voice commands into console commands. The customizable commands gives more flexibility and provides more elegant user experience.
- Integrated MongoDB and Express backend to store user’s score and name to display top 5 scores.
- Utilized HTML Audio Tag to insert sounds for background music, and sound effects to increase engagement of the player to the game. Also, added mute/unmute functionality.
- Created countdown functionality before starting the game using setTimeout function to increase user experience.

projects.title: u&i
projects.description:
Full-stack team-built web application where a couple share their moments with calendar, stickys, and albums

| MongoDB | Express | React | Node.js | HTML5 | SCSS |

- Integrated react-calendar to display upcoming events for this month and the next month on click of the calendar. 
- Generated a separate function in react component to use different class names based on the author id to display different backgrounds of the stickys.
- Designed the splash page and login/signup page using SCSS.
- Implemented Connected, Auth, and Protected Routes using react-router-dom so that when two users were connected, they would not be able to access the connection page.  Frontend routing, to Re-route the user based on their status.
